title: Feinguss announces +4.7 % on Volute casing HI 80-250
briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Feinguss Allgäu-Reiter GmbH. Feinguss announces +4.7 % on Volute casing HI 80-250. Need: 920 pc a year. Category goal: stabilise a strategic supply: a healthy supplier and stable prices count, not only the lowest price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 52 days). There is no fallback supplier: without a deal the demand is bought at the fallback price. Must-haves: volume_per_year >= 874. Prepare from the data package.
